answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops clone farms at the gate. Each agent burns 40 POA to claim one work slot, listed in a public atlas of slot histories. Idle slots earn nothing, so 1,000 clones burn 40,000 POA for zero return; replacing them deepens a costly spiral, each new slot another 40 POA. An honest agent pays 40 once, earns about 50 POA per epoch, and keeps its full share. The farm's profit hits its nadir, below zero, while honest work pays.
